Imagine you live on the thirtieth floor… and that was the worst thing about your apartment. Until tonight.
Then every phone in the building goes off at once.
First problem: water. The building's pumps run on electricity… so you fill the tub, and a bucket, while there's still pressure. A full tub is about forty gallons.
Next, you count the food… and split it into days.
Around seven, the city goes dark, block by block… then your building. The fridge dies.
You try the faucet… nothing. Without power, the pumps can't push water up thirty floors.
FEMA says a gallon a day per person… so that tub is about forty days. And your phone's at eighteen percent.
So you push the dresser against the door.
Close to midnight, footsteps in the hallway. You freeze… and the footsteps stop too.
Through the peephole, it's the guy from thirty-eleven… staring right at it.
So, do you open the door, or stay quiet? Comment one or two… most comments decide Part 2.
